name: Currency Conversion 5
definition: Exchange rate and calculated amount to be presented to the customer when the dispense currency or the deposit currency (target currency) is different to account currency (source currency).

SourceCurrency.name: Source Currency
SourceCurrency.definition: Currency from which the amount is converted (ISO 4217, 3 alphanumeric characters).

SourceCurrencyNumeric.name: Source Currency Numeric
SourceCurrencyNumeric.definition: Currency from which the amount is converted (ISO 4217, 3 numeric characters).

TargetCurrency.name: Target Currency
TargetCurrency.definition: Currency into which the amount is converted (ISO 4217, 3 alphanumeric characters).

TargetCurrencyNumeric.name: Target Currency Numeric
TargetCurrencyNumeric.definition: Currency into which the amount is converted (ISO 4217, 3 numeric characters).

CalculatedAmount.name: Calculated Amount
CalculatedAmount.definition: Resulting calculated amount is in target currency.
